text:
maya: rolled gptx-4o-small (q8_0) to prod ~08:30 UTC. seeing weird delimiter leakage + token duplication on long contexts (>2k). quick repro below.

maya: ```
PROMPT:
<system> You are a helpful assistant. </system>
User: Summarize the following long document... (2.5k tokens)
```

maya: output contains repeated chunks and stray delimiter markers like `--- END ---` showing up multiple times mid-summary. also a few cases where previous convo fragments appear.
ahmet: can you paste an actual output snippet (no PII)?
maya: ```
Summary: The file details the migration plan... --- END ---
Summary: The file details the migration plan... --- END ---
Additional notes: refer to ticket ML-...
```
samir: sounds like quant rounding / dequant noise causing repetition on long-range KV. repeat-rate up for seq>2k. i'll run the long-context bench.
ellie: infra note: kernel selector logs show a fallback path getting used for many requests to this model, which explains a latency uplift. pinned logs:```
WARN kernel_selector: fallback to generic_kernel for model gptx-4o-small q8_0
METRIC latency.p95 1.2s -> 3.7s after rollout
```
zach: can we pin affected traffic to fp16 variant while triaging? prefer not to impact customers.
maya: yes please. opening routing rollback now. also we should run tokenizer regression checks — new model had tokenizer changes in the release branch.
ahmet: note: tokenizer merges included a change to control-token handling. if token ids shifted, quant tables might map weirdly. check tokenizer.vocab checksum vs model tokenizer config.
samir: quick numbers from eval shard (long-context, 1k samples):
- fp16 baseline: repeat-rate (seq>2k) 0.6%
- q8_0 prod: repeat-rate (seq>2k) 4.8%
- perplexity delta: +2.1
- coherence score (our metric) dropped 3.3 pts
I'll attach raw CSV to the ticket.

ellie: routing PR #3421 opened, canary rolled to 10% and then 0% after we saw regressions. monitoring dashboards updated.
deploy-bot: deploy gptx-4o-small q8_0 -> prod at 2026-03-17T08:30:05Z by maya
zach: proposed immediate action list: (1) route affected customers to fp16 fallback, (2) run tokenizer checksum diff, (3) re-run quantization with tighter clipping (q8_1), (4) force kernel selection for long seq if fallback persists.
maya: agreed. creating bug ML-8243 and tagging eng-runtime + infra + quant-team. also flagging as P1 for onboarding.
samir: i'll try q8_1 from quant team and re-run the long-context eval, report by EOD. if q8_1 fixes repeat-rate we can re-roll with a canary.
ahmet: i'll audit tokenizer commits and post diff + repro harness. maybe a quick unit test to catch this in future.
ellie: infra will check kernel selector flags and see if a runtime hotfix to prefer the optimized kernel is safe.
zach: added blocker label on onboarding ticket and notified CS to prep customer comms in case of escalations.
maya: thanks all — will update this thread as we get more numbers. :thumbsup:
